capabilities.text: Build a tree of 2 to 16 taxa in clades nested inside clades, in any order
Mark a trait as a tick on the branch leading into each clade
capabilities.note: ours writes a name at an ancestor node (a name after a bracket), not a tick on the branch

capabilities.text: Mark one trait on the root, shared by every taxon
Start from a ready-made tree: vertebrates, land plants, apes, or taxa A to F with numbered traits
Draw the branches diagonally with the taxa along the top, instead of rectangular with the taxa down the right
capabilities.note: ours' slanted shape keeps the taxa down the right side

capabilities.text: Write the taxon names, or leave blank lines for them
Leave any one taxon's name blank
Write the traits, leave numbered blank lines, draw ticks alone, or leave them off
